name: University of Bath
summary: A campus university in Bath, south-west England, with over 190 degrees, many with an optional paid placement year; IB offers often 35–36 points.

ib.text: Offers give a total and three HL grades, e.g. 35 with 6,5,5 (Modern Languages) or 36 with 7,6,6 incl. HL Maths 6 (Accounting and Finance). With four HLs, your best three count.

dates.label: UCAS equal consideration deadline, 18:00 UK time

programmes.name: Sport and Exercise Science
programmes.about: The science of sport and health: physiology, biomechanics, nutrition and sport psychology, with labs and a Sports Training Village on campus, then a research project of your own design in the final two years.
programmes.ib: 36 points with 6,6,6 or 7,6,5 at HL, including 6 in one HL science or maths: Biology, Chemistry, Maths, Physics, Psychology or Sports, Exercise and Health Science.
programmes.selectionNote: The personal statement should show enthusiasm for the subject, for example reading, work experience or sport. Geography or PE cannot replace the science.

flagshipSource.title: Sport and Exercise Science: a £35 million Sports Training Village for more than 50 sports (course page)

programmes.name: Integrated Design Engineering
programmes.about: For creative engineers: mechanical, electrical and software skills combined to design products, machines and systems, with core engineering in years 1 and 2 and creative design and innovation after that.
programmes.ib: 36 points with 7,7,6 at HL, including 6 in Physics and 7 in HL Maths (AA or AI). Maths is required at HL.
programmes.selectionNote: Your UCAS personal statement alone is assessed, so make it about engineering. Decisions wait until after the January deadline.

flagshipSource.title: Integrated Design Engineering: mechanical, electrical and software skills in one design degree (course page)

programmes.name: Modern Languages (with study or work abroad)
programmes.about: Reach fluency in two languages, choosing two advanced ones or one with a beginner language, and learn the culture, history and politics of the countries involved, with a year studying or working abroad.
programmes.ib: 35 points with 6,5,5 at HL. An advanced language needs HL 5 (or SL 7) in it, or B2 shown another way.
programmes.selectionNote: The personal statement should show interest in the social, political or cultural side of the languages. An interview may test a language qualification not covered.

flagshipSource.title: Modern Languages: fluency in two languages plus a year of study or work abroad (course page)

notes: Overseas fees for 2027 entry are £26,150 (humanities and social sciences), £29,500 (economics and management) or £32,950 (science and engineering) a year.
Placement years are usually paid, but Bath does not guarantee you a placement; its Placements Team helps you apply.

faculties.name: Faculty of Engineering & Design
faculties.line: Four departments with an optional placement; Integrated Design Engineering asks 36 points with 7,7,6 incl. HL Maths 7 and Physics 6.

faculties.name: Faculty of Humanities & Social Sciences
faculties.line: Six departments; Modern Languages asks 35 points with 6,5,5 at HL; Sport and Exercise Science needs a HL science.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science
faculties.line: Six departments, from Chemistry to Physics; most courses include a placement option, and many can be taken as an integrated master's.

faculties.name: School of Management
faculties.line: Business, Management and International Management with languages; most are four years with a work placement or study abroad.
